story.text: Do not confuse a [[Conversation for Possibilities]] with a [[Conversation for Action]]. The best way to avoid this common mistake is to lean and use the [[Conversation for Action]] as formally or informally as needed.

Always start with: **[[Background of Understanding]]**
Follow with: **[[Conditions of Satisfaction, Time Specified]]**
If one has a performer with a sufficiently shared background of understanding and the requester is very clear on the conditions of satisfaction with time specified, then enter into a conversation for action.
Conversation for Action, Institute for Generative Leadership, Bob Dunham
